svg.title: Authorize evidence before generation
svg.desc: Synthetic on-site RAG architecture. Approved sources retain tenant, permissions and version through parsing and indexing. Authenticated identity limits eligible candidates before scoring. Context is rechecked against current policy and source versions. A local generator produces raw output subject to separate support and task checks. Revocation returns to retrieval and context; no known conflict permits release.

g.text: 1. Approved source and parser
Document ID, tenant, group ACL and version
Plain text fixture; no OCR security claim
2. Chunk and index
Keep source metadata on each chunk
Version the retrieval build and location
3. Authorize before scoring
Eligible tenant / group / active / trusted
Then vectors, ranking and any reranker
Trusted identity
Not a tenant claim
inside the question
4. Recheck context
Canonical span, current version and epoch
Stale or unauthorized: stop and retrieve again
Policy changes
Revoke / delete / update
Invalidate stale context
5. Local generation
Only authorized evidence enters the prompt
Raw output does not receive automatic approval
6. Separate answer checks and accountable review
Citation validity · claim support · format · language/task behavior
Answer, abstain or withhold. Known access/site conflict blocks release.
Same boundary: OCR, embeddings, cache, logs, support and recovery
No external fallback under unchanged premises / air-gap requirements.

svg.text: Editable SVG. Synthetic teaching fixture; independent and production assurance pending.
Process offline settings do not prove a physical air gap. See lesson for source ledger.
